result.final_answer: Structure: Cargo.toml declares 28 members under crates/, all read. They form 14 name-prefix groups of two, such as core, fx, session, compute, pax, graph, wasm, native, inference. Responsibilities: every package description says only "owns one responsibility in the workspace", so individual roles are not established. Dependencies: chip-core-0 has no internal dependencies and every other crate depends on it. Higher-numbered crates depend on lower-numbered ones, e.g. chip-inference-27 depends on core-0, pax-5, decision-9 and inference-13. External: serde and toml; dev: tempfile (chip-inference-27/Cargo.toml). Not shown: runtime behavior, build dependencies, and README.md, which I did not read.
